Our Mission

At WeRep, our mission is to enable businesses and individuals to leverage our multidisciplinary versatility and local knowledge to optimise their operations in the UK without having to physically visit the UK. Thereby saving on travelling expenses, reducing their carbon footprint and more importantly hitting the ground running in the UK.

Our Core Values

Sustainability
Integrity
Accountability
Innovation
Excellence
Respect

Sustainability

Representing companies and individuals in the UK means they don't have to fly or travel to the UK, thereby reducing carbon footprints. We strive to mitigate environmental impacts across all operations. Before you make your next UK trip, think if we can save you the Time, Money, Air-miles and Carbon footprint whilst leveraging our versatility and local knowledge to achieve even more efficiency.

Integrity

Rooted in ethics and trustworthiness, we maintain the highest moral standards in all we do.

Accountability

We take full responsibility for our actions and outcomes—owning both success and failure.

Innovation

By embracing new ideas, we continuously evolve our service quality and delivery methods.

Excellence

We strive for world-class standards, consistently aiming to exceed expectations and improve continuously.

Respect

Treating all stakeholders with fairness, dignity, and empathy irrespective of socioeconomic background or perspective.

from xml.etree.ElementTree import Element, SubElement, tostring from xml.dom import minidom from math import cos, sin, radians # Constants center_x, center_y = 400, 400 # Center of canvas radius = 250 box_size = 120 angle_step = 72 # Values data values = [ {"title": "Integrity", "icon": "🛡️", "desc": "Rooted in ethics and trustworthiness, we maintain the highest moral standards in all we do."}, {"title": "Accountability", "icon": "⚖️", "desc": "We take full responsibility for our actions and outcomes—owning both success and failure."}, {"title": "Innovation", "icon": "💡", "desc": "By embracing new ideas, we continuously evolve our service quality and delivery methods."}, {"title": "Excellence", "icon": "🏆", "desc": "We strive for world-class standards, consistently aiming to exceed expectations and improve continuously."}, {"title": "Respect", "icon": "🤝", "desc": "Treating all stakeholders with fairness, dignity, and empathy irrespective of socioeconomic background or perspective."} ] # Create root SVG element svg = Element('svg', width='800', height='800', xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', style='background:#1a1a1a') # Central box center_group = SubElement(svg, 'g') SubElement(center_group, 'rect', x=str(center_x - 90), y=str(center_y - 90), width="180", height="180", fill="#2d2d2d", stroke="#facc15", stroke_width="4", rx="10") SubElement(center_group, 'text', x=str(center_x), y=str(center_y - 50), fill="#facc15", font_size="32", font_family="Arial", text_anchor="middle").text = "🌿" SubElement(center_group, 'text', x=str(center_x), y=str(center_y - 10), fill="#fcd34d", font_size="16", font_family="Arial", font_weight="bold", text_anchor="middle").text = "Sustainability" SubElement(center_group, 'text', x=str(center_x), y=str(center_y + 20), fill="#d1d5db", font_size="10", font_family="Arial", text_anchor="middle").text = "Reducing travel emissions" SubElement(center_group, 'text', x=str(center_x), y=str(center_y + 34), fill="#d1d5db", font_size="10", font_family="Arial", text_anchor="middle").text = "through representation in the UK." # Outer value boxes for i, val in enumerate(values): angle_deg = i * angle_step - 90 angle_rad = radians(angle_deg) x = center_x + radius * cos(angle_rad) - box_size / 2 y = center_y + radius * sin(angle_rad) - box_size / 2 group = SubElement(svg, 'g') SubElement(group, 'rect', x=str(x), y=str(y), width=str(box_size), height=str(box_size), fill="#374151", rx="10") SubElement(group, 'text', x=str(x + box_size / 2), y=str(y + 24), fill="#facc15", font_size="20", font_family="Arial", text_anchor="middle").text = val["icon"] SubElement(group, 'text', x=str(x + box_size / 2), y=str(y + 45), fill="#fcd34d", font_size="12", font_family="Arial", font_weight="bold", text_anchor="middle").text = val["title"] lines = val["desc"].split() line1 = " ".join(lines[:6]) line2 = " ".join(lines[6:12]) line3 = " ".join(lines[12:18]) SubElement(group, 'text', x=str(x + box_size / 2), y=str(y + 65), fill="#d1d5db", font_size="8", font_family="Arial", text_anchor="middle").text = line1 SubElement(group, 'text', x=str(x + box_size / 2), y=str(y + 75), fill="#d1d5db", font_size="8", font_family="Arial", text_anchor="middle").text = line2 SubElement(group, 'text', x=str(x + box_size / 2), y=str(y + 85), fill="#d1d5db", font_size="8", font_family="Arial", text_anchor="middle").text = line3 # Pretty-printing the SVG rough_string = tostring(svg, 'utf-8') reparsed = minidom.parseString(rough_string) pretty_svg = reparsed.toprettyxml(indent=" ") # Save the SVG to a file file_path = "/mnt/data/values_infographic.svg" with open(file_path, "w") as f: f.write(pretty_svg) file_path
